sections.name: इतिहास, राजनीति एवं संस्कृति (History, Polity & Culture)
विज्ञान, गणित एवं रीजनिंग (Science, Maths & Reasoning)

subjects.name: Rajasthan History
subjects.section: इतिहास, राजनीति एवं संस्कृति (History, Polity & Culture)
subjects.scope_note: Rajasthan's princely states, dynasties, forts, treaties, freedom movement within Rajasthan, peasant/tribal movements -- anything historical specific to Rajasthan.

subjects.name: Rajasthan Geography
subjects.scope_note: Rajasthan's physical/agro-climatic zones, rivers, soils, minerals, climate, wildlife/forests, districts, irrigation -- physical or economic geography of Rajasthan specifically.

subjects.name: Rajasthan Polity & Administration
subjects.section: इतिहास, राजनीति एवं संस्कृति (History, Polity & Culture)
subjects.scope_note: Rajasthan's state government structure, Panchayati Raj / local self-government in Rajasthan, state assembly, governor, state-specific administrative/legal setup.

subjects.name: Rajasthan Economy
subjects.scope_note: Rajasthan-specific industries, agriculture, schemes, economic planning, tourism as an industry, census/demographic economic data for Rajasthan.

subjects.name: Rajasthan Art & Culture
subjects.section: इतिहास, राजनीति एवं संस्कृति (History, Polity & Culture)
subjects.scope_note: Rajasthan's folk culture, festivals, dance, music, painting styles, fairs, saints/folk deities, dialects, cuisine, handicrafts, monuments as cultural (not historical-political) sites.

subjects.name: Rajasthan Current Affairs
subjects.scope_note: Recent (last ~1-2 years relative to the exam) news, appointments, schemes, awards, events specific to Rajasthan.

subjects.name: Indian History
subjects.section: इतिहास, राजनीति एवं संस्कृति (History, Polity & Culture)
subjects.scope_note: National/pan-India history not specific to Rajasthan -- ancient/medieval/modern India, the freedom struggle at the national level.

subjects.name: Indian Geography
subjects.scope_note: India's physical/economic geography at the national level, not Rajasthan-specific.

subjects.name: Indian Polity
subjects.section: इतिहास, राजनीति एवं संस्कृति (History, Polity & Culture)
subjects.scope_note: The Indian Constitution, Union government structure, judiciary, elections, national-level governance.

subjects.name: Indian Economy
subjects.scope_note: National economic policy, planning, banking, national schemes, national census/demographic data.

subjects.name: World Geography
subjects.scope_note: Geography outside India (continents, world physical features, global economic geography).

subjects.name: General Science
subjects.section: विज्ञान, गणित एवं रीजनिंग (Science, Maths & Reasoning)
subjects.scope_note: Physics/chemistry/biology/technology facts not tied to current events.

subjects.name: Current Affairs (National/International)
subjects.scope_note: Recent news at the national or international level (not Rajasthan-specific).

subjects.name: Educational Psychology
subjects.section: विज्ञान, गणित एवं रीजनिंग (Science, Maths & Reasoning)
subjects.scope_note: Theories of learning, child development, pedagogy, psychologists/theorists -- the Educational Psychology paper's own subject matter.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.section: विज्ञान, गणित एवं रीजनिंग (Science, Maths & Reasoning)
subjects.scope_note: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, numerical/quantitative aptitude calculations -- the question requires computing or manipulating numbers.

subjects.name: Reasoning & Mental Ability
subjects.section: विज्ञान, गणित एवं रीजनिंग (Science, Maths & Reasoning)
subjects.scope_note: Logical reasoning, analogies, series completion, coding-decoding, classification (odd-one-out), figure/pattern-based puzzles, blood relations, direction sense -- tests reasoning ability itself, not GK facts.

subjects.name: Computer Knowledge
subjects.section: विज्ञान, गणित एवं रीजनिंग (Science, Maths & Reasoning)
subjects.scope_note: Computer hardware/software basics, MS Office, internet, operating systems, abbreviations (RAM, USB, CD-R, etc.) -- computer literacy as its own subject, not "General Science" (only put a computing question here, not in General Science).

subjects.name: English Language
subjects.scope_note: English grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, synonyms/antonyms, sentence correction, idioms -- ONLY when the question is testing English language skill itself (e.g. "choose the correct tense"). A GK question that merely happens to be printed in English stays in its real GK subject, not here.

subjects.name: Hindi Language
subjects.scope_note: Hindi grammar (sandhi, samas, muhavare), vocabulary (vilom/paryayvachi shabd), sentence correction -- ONLY when the question is testing Hindi language skill itself. A GK question merely printed in Hindi stays in its real GK subject, not here.
